sloka: भवान् एव महीम् कृत्स्नाम् एको रक्षितुम् अर्हति ।न भूम्या कार्यम् अस्माकम् न हि शक्ताः स्म पालने ॥१-१४-४७॥
transliteration: bhavān eva mahīm kṛtsnām eko rakṣitum arhati ।na bhūmyā kāryam asmākam na hi śaktāḥ sma pālane ॥1-14-47॥

translations.english: Lord of men, the king having been thus addressed by brahmins who were wellversed in the Vedas, bestowed on them ten hundred thousand cows, a hundred crore of gold coins and four times as much in silver coins.
